system_name.reference: Graphiti is a framework for building and querying temporal context graphs for AI agents.
system_name.matched_span: Graphiti is a framework for building and querying temporal context graphs for AI agents.

system_category.reference: Graphiti is a framework for building and querying temporal context graphs for AI agents. Unlike static knowledge graphs, Graphiti's context graphs track how facts change over time
system_category.matched_span: Graphiti is a framework for building and querying temporal context graphs for AI agents. Unlike static knowledge graphs, Graphiti's context graphs track how facts change over time

knowledge_representation.reference: A context graph contains: Entities (nodes), Facts / Relationships (edges), Episodes (provenance), Custom Types (ontology) — Developer-defined entity and edge types via Pydantic models
knowledge_representation.matched_span: A context graph contains: Entities (nodes), Facts / Relationships (edges), Episodes (provenance), Custom Types (ontology) — Developer-defined entity and edge types via Pydantic models

retrieval_mechanism.reference: Query across time, meaning, and relationships with hybrid retrieval (semantic + keyword + graph traversal).
retrieval_mechanism.matched_span: Query across time, meaning, and relationships with hybrid retrieval (semantic + keyword + graph traversal).

knowledge_source.reference: Graphiti continuously integrates user interactions, structured and unstructured enterprise data, and external information into a coherent, queryable graph.
knowledge_source.matched_span: Graphiti continuously integrates user interactions, structured and unstructured enterprise data, and external information into a coherent, queryable graph.

supported_modality.reference: Adding episodes to the graph (both text and structured JSON)

reasoning_strategy.reference: Build context graphs that evolve with every interaction — tracking what's true now and what was true before. Give agents rich, structured context instead of flat document chunks or raw chat history.
